bio.text: Jimmy Panetta represents California's 19th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and was first elected in 2016.
His district runs from south San Jose through Santa Cruz and Monterey Counties into northern San Luis Obispo County.
He serves on the House Committees on Ways and Means and on the Budget, and is a Chief Deputy Whip in the 119th Congress.
